overall_assessment: The authorization, tenancy, and data residency controls codified across crates/searchright-access/src/lib.rs, crates/searchright-contracts/src/access.rs, contracts/examples/tenant-policy.json, contracts/examples/access-request.json, contracts/examples/access-decision.json, and verification/receipts/remote-mcp-tenancy-adversarial.json demonstrate impeccable default-deny governance and strict methodological safeguards. In crates/searchright-access/src/lib.rs, the authorise and authorise_with_replay engines evaluate incoming AccessRequests against validated TenantPolicies. Tenant isolation is strictly enforced: any request where request.tenant_id != policy.tenant_id is denied fail-closed with access.tenant.mismatch. Regional data residency boundaries are locked to the policy's allowed_regions (e.g., 'AU'); requests originating from or targeting unauthorized regions are denied with access.region.denied. Capability authorization is strictly default-deny: requested scopes must be explicitly present in policy.allowed_scopes; unrequested or unapproved scopes trigger access.scope.denied.<scope>. Critically, non-human agents are strictly barred from autonomous study exclusions or final eligibility determinations: when request.final_eligibility_decision is true, the engine mandates that principal_kind == PrincipalKind::Human, scopes include AccessScope::ScreeningDecide, and human_approval == true; non-human principals fail closed with access.final_decision.human_only. Similarly, external_write operations demand both the external_write scope and explicit human approval. Furthermore, the policy evaluator accumulates all encountered control violations into decision.blockers, ensuring comprehensive auditability rather than masking secondary infractions behind the first failure.
verified_invariants: fail-closed tenant isolation: cross-tenant access requests (request.tenant_id != policy.tenant_id) are blocked with access.tenant.mismatch
regional data residency boundary: requests targeting regions outside policy.allowed_regions are rejected with access.region.denied
default-deny capability scoping: scopes not explicitly granted in policy.allowed_scopes are rejected with access.scope.denied.<scope>
strict human-only final screening decisions: non-human agent principals are categorically forbidden from autonomous study exclusion or final eligibility decisions (access.final_decision.human_only)
mandatory human approval for external writes: external write operations require both external_write scope and explicit human approval
multiple violation accumulation: adversarial test multiple_control_violations_accumulate_blockers proves multiple control violations accumulate completely in blockers list
read-only remote surface boundary: the 31 exposed MCP tools are strictly read-only and require review_read scope, preventing remote mutation authority
deterministic verification: all access governance unit tests in tests/test_authenticated_remote_mcp_governance.py and adversarial tenancy tests pass 100% network-free

findings.description: Tenant policy and access request contracts enforce strict in-process tenancy and region residency; validating cloud infrastructure storage, database replication, and audit log residency at the physical host level remains an open operational gate.
findings.recommendation: Preserve open gate T34-G-DATA-RESIDENCY-VERIFICATION until physical and logical cloud storage replication boundaries are verified in production.

findings.description: The authenticated_read_request constructor in crates/searchright-access/src/lib.rs hardcodes external_write: false, final_eligibility_decision: false, and human_approval: false, ensuring the HTTP adapter cannot be tricked into granting write or screening decision authority.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the architectural separation between the read-only remote adapter and state-changing review workflows.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Default-deny capability authorization, scope enforcement, and strict prohibition of non-human agent autonomous study exclusion/final decisions verified in Rust and Python suites.
Tenant isolation, regional data residency boundaries, and accumulation of multiple control violations verified in adversarial test suites.

limitations: Source and fixture-proven in-process tenant and region validation only; distributed multi-replica tenancy and physical cloud data residency remain open operational gates.
